guardrails: planning artifacts do not ingest analysis datasets
planning artifacts do not execute risk maps, abundance inference, human case maps, Rt, spillover, host-switch, or surveillance joins
each source still requires provenance, terms, field-schema, and bias review before analysis

plan.analysis_scope: human surveillance export planning only; no human case map or Rt estimation
plan.case_definition_policy: record ECDC disease/reporting definition from source page before comparing across sources
plan.export_route: public Atlas interface CSV export by time period, region, indicator, and current/all indicators
plan.privacy_suppression_rule: use only aggregate public exports; preserve any suppressed/missing cells as released
